references.text: Luke 24:1-12 describes Jesus' resurrection and how Mary Magdalene and the other women found the tomb empty.
Matthew 28:1-10 tells of Jesus' resurrection and how he appeared to Mary Magdalene and another Mary.
John 20:1-18 gives a detailed account of Jesus' resurrection, including how Mary Magdalene was the first he appeared to.
Mark 16:1-8 tells of the women who went to the tomb and found it empty, although this passage does not specifically mention Jesus appearing to Mary Magdalene as in verse 9.
